decisions.scenario: Choosing a modern European restaurant and then checking a Wednesday train from Broxbourne to Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a place to eat in the centre that serves modern European food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are four modern European restaurants in the centre. Darrys Cookhouse and Wine Shop is a popular option. Would you like a reservation?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Not right now. I also need a train from Broxbourne to Cambridge on Wednesday that leaves after 15:00.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR5972 leaves Broxbourne at 15:32 and arrives in Cambridge at 16:32. Would you like to buy a ticket?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Not at this time, thanks. That's all I need today.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a lovely day.

decisions.scenario: Checking an early Sunday train from Kings Lynn to Cambridge and visiting the Regency Gallery

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Are there any trains from Kings Lynn to Cambridge on Sunday that arrive by 11:30?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. Train TR6003 leaves at 05:11 and arrives at 05:58, while TR0412 leaves at 06:11 and arrives at 06:58. Would you like to book either one?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, thank you. I have the train information I need.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. I'd like information about the Regency Gallery.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The Regency Gallery is a museum in the centre at 39 Fitzroy Street. Admission is free.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's all I needed. Thank you so much!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Happy to help. Enjoy your time in Cambridge!
